posts.title: The Newest Technology in Frozen
posts.description: There are lots of different things in Frozen that are new-ish, but my dad and I were wondering: what is the actual newest thing in Frozen? This led me to watch Frozen a lot while taking notes. Some of the things I found included: Elastic hair-ties A safety bicycle Sunscreen Bottle of aloe Lacquer Pompoms, the kind you get at a store and not the kind with yarn Off the shoulder Paper straws Sunglass
